note: Minimal router-facing action metadata. action_semantic_version is independent of the CI-owned _SKILL_VERSION: bump it only when an action's meaning or boundary changes. nearest_confusions lists the eligible-but-wrong neighbours a router most often confuses (the hard negatives). Eligibility itself lives in predicates.py.

aggregate-temporal.short_description: Roll a time or lead axis up into fixed windows (daily, weekly, dekadal, monthly) with mean/min/max; rates stay rates.

convert-to-totals.short_description: Multiply an aggregated rate by its stamped aggregation_period to give period totals (mm).

deaccumulate.short_description: Turn a cumulative-since-init forecast along its lead axis into per-step rates.

step-to-time.short_description: Replace a forecast's lead axis with wall-clock valid time (init + lead).

clip-region.short_description: Subset a dataset to a bbox or GeoJSON polygon.

coarsen.short_description: Linearly interpolate onto a coarser or equal target grid, preferably another dataset's grid via --reference-grid.

downscale.short_description: Move onto a finer-or-equal grid by linear interpolation or empirical q-q mapping against a reference.

difference.short_description: Subtract dataset B from A cell by cell with inner-join alignment.

verify.short_description: Score a forecast against observations on a shared grid: hits, bias or MAE (ensemble mean).

standardize-anomaly.short_description: Z-score a field against a climatology's mean and standard deviation.

indicator.short_description: Apply a daily boolean rule (windowed thresholds, onset, spells) per member, optionally reduced to ensemble probability or first-true date.

summarize-dim.short_description: Collapse named dimensions with mean/std/min/max/sum/median (e.g. ensemble spread, time-mean baseline).

unit-convert.short_description: Convert variables to target units (pint/CF) or to standard display units.

select.short_description: Pick entries along one dimension by position or value; a single pick collapses the dim.

convert-calendar.short_description: Convert the time axis to a target CF calendar; unrepresentable dates are dropped.

clim-fetch.short_description: Fetch a PRECOMPUTED daily climatology (avg + std) for a named dataset and expand it onto a requested window.
